Improving Quality of Life

Select Medical treats approximately 80,000 patients in a typical day. Ranging from some of the most critically ill individuals in our nation's health care system to some of the most fit athletes, our patients benefit from the combined knowledge and expertise of over 50,000 employees. Our people are dedicated to providing a great patient experience. It is the Select Medical Way.
